---
title: "OpenAI-compatible server with ServerProcess"
description: "Run the bundled vLLM OpenAI-compatible server on Kaggle T4 GPUs with stokastisk.serving.ServerProcess: health checks, streaming chat, Prometheus metrics, restart and graceful shutdown."
guide-section: "Inference"
---

`stokastisk.serving` runs the bundled `vllm serve` as a supervised child process with the T4 defaults, and offers small client helpers built on the standard library. Use it from a notebook cell or script.

```python
from stokastisk import serving

with serving.ServerProcess("Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct") as srv:
    srv.wait_ready()
    print(serving.chat(srv.base_url, srv.served_model_name, [{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}]))
    print("".join(serving.stream_chat(srv.base_url, srv.served_model_name,
                                      [{"role": "user", "content": "Count to five."}])))
```

Leaving the `with` block stops the server. It is never started implicitly or left running.

## `ServerProcess(model, config=None, *, ...)`

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | none | model id or path |
| `config` | `StokastiskConfig.from_env()` | T4 defaults (environment variables apply); `replica_parallel` is refused |
| `host`, `port` | `127.0.0.1`, `8000` | `find_free_port()` returns a free port |
| `served_model_name` | `model` | the name clients send |
| `quantization` | `None` | refused if the method needs a GPU newer than SM75 |
| `extra_args` | `()` | additional `vllm serve` arguments |
| `cuda_visible_devices` | `None` | for example `"0"` |
| `log_path` | temp file | server output; kept after `stop()` |

Always passed: `--attention-backend TRITON_ATTN`, FP16 and the pinned xgrammar backend.

| Member | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `start()`, `wait_ready(timeout=600)`, `start_and_wait()` | start, then poll `/health` until it answers 200 |
| `health()` | `True` if `/health` answers now |
| `restart()` | graceful stop then a fresh start on the same port |
| `stop(grace=30)` | SIGINT, then SIGTERM, then SIGKILL on the process group; returns the exit code |
| `base_url`, `pid`, `running`, `command`, `log_path`, `served_model_name` | state |
| `log_tail(max_lines)` | last lines of the server log |
| `shutdown_report` | which signals were needed and whether children survived |

If start-up fails, `ServerStartupError` carries the exit code, the exact command, the log path and the last log lines.

## Client helpers

| Function | Returns |
|---|---|
| `chat(base_url, model, messages, *, max_tokens=64, temperature=0.0, timeout=120)` | assistant text |
| `stream_chat(...)` | generator of text deltas; a truncated stream raises `ServerHTTPError` |
| `list_models(base_url)` | the `/v1/models` response |
| `fetch_metrics(base_url)` | Prometheus `/metrics` parsed to `{sample: value}` |

You can also call the server with any OpenAI client, using `base_url=f"{srv.base_url}/v1"` and any API key.

## Utilities

`build_serve_command(model, config, ...)` returns the exact argv and starts nothing. Also `find_free_port()`, `port_is_free(host, port)`, `check_server_requirements()` (lists missing serving packages), `validate_model_id`, `validate_host` and `validate_port`. See the [serving module reference](../reference/index.html).

## Evidence and conditions

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Server start, `/health`, `/v1/models`, chat completions, SSE streaming, HTTP error mapping, structured output over HTTP, `/metrics`, restart on the same port, graceful SIGINT shutdown, GPU memory released | Kaggle-tested on build 3 (notebook 15 server stage, 21 of 21 checks) |
| Model and mode | Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct at TP=1 only |
| `/metrics` | presence of `vllm:` samples was asserted, not their values |
| SageMaker `/ping` and `/invocations` routes | **not exercised and not claimed** |
| Kaggle's `fastapi 0.141.1` vs upstream vLLM's `<0.137` cap | the app built and served on Kaggle; see [Dependency compatibility](dependency-compatibility.qmd) |
| Calling upstream `vllm serve` directly | **unsupported**: it bypasses the SDK's dtype, NCCL and structured-output checks |
